name: Hiramatsu
source:
One of the new nurses. She is a super slacker and has no desire to get things done. 

When she was Yamada's nurse, you would find her sleeping in his bed. She thinks it is more efficient for others to work diligently than for her

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
